_README: REFERENCE keep-regions for the auto-mask spike. These are AGENT-AUTHORED, not Andre's hand-drawn masks:
no apply artifacts or drawn masks exist on this Mac (uploads/, temp_extracted/ empty). Method: max-intensity
projection over ALL frames -> same support/fit pipeline at 2x -> visual review on out/_refs/<clip>.png ->
hand-corrected where the automatic candidate followed echo content instead of the imaging geometry.
Coordinates are full-resolution frame pixels. fan_px: apex (ax,ay), radii, angles in degrees (0 = straight
down, + = right). poly_px: closed polygon. clip_to_box: intersect with the DICOM (0018,6011) region box.
'edited' says what was changed from refs_candidates.json and why. Replace with Andre's masks before sign-off.

bfly_z3.note: edited twice: candidate was a 7-vertex quad; cone is a fan clipped by the 736-px frame on both sides and at the top. Apex from the two visible side edges (218,0)-(0,450) and (504,0)-(734,444). FIRST hand version used the frame corners (0,1026)/(734,1022) for the angles (+/-15 deg) — wrong, those are frame edges not cone sides; the side lines themselves give -25.8/+27.4 deg, which is what the T1 fit had found. Corrected 2026-09-04 after the T1 'leak' on this clip turned out to be reference error.
